summary: Frontend-only testing of the new /book page and landing-page integration for 'Currency Trading and Intermarket Analysis'. Validated nav links, BookSection teaser, /book hero, accordion (9 chapters), all CTAs (Amazon external w/ target=_blank, internal /book and / routes), scroll-to-top on nav, mobile drawer Book link, direct URL load, document title, and that landing still renders ($550/$995 pricing, 2 SPONSORED floating ads at xl). All 32 assertions passed with zero console/page errors.

issues: Sheet overlay dim backdrop briefly persists after Link navigation (framer-motion exit on unmounted Header). Non-blocking visual flash only; page is interactive.

critical_code_review_comments: BookPage.jsx accordion uses array index `i` as React key (key={i}); minor — fine since list is static, but using ch.title would be more robust.
BookPage useEffect cleanup resets document.title to the WhatsApp landing title — works for SPA navigation but if a user lands directly on /book and then closes the tab, the title is fine. Acceptable.
BOOK_COVER served from customer-assets.emergentagent.com (natural width 855px) and is hot-linked; consider self-hosting/optimizing for performance and reliability.
Amazon AMAZON_URL includes affiliate tag — verify this is intentional and tag belongs to Ashraf (it does: tag=ashlaidi-20).
No 404/catch-all route in App.js — any unknown path renders nothing. Minor: consider adding NotFound route.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Book feature verified end-to-end on iteration 2. Validated testids: nav-link-book, mobile-nav-link-book, book-section, book-section-cover-link, book-section-explore-cta (-> /book), book-section-buy-cta (amazon, _blank, noopener noreferrer), book-page, book-header, book-header-wordmark, book-back-link, book-header-buy-cta, book-hero, book-cover-image, book-hero-buy-cta, book-hero-back-cta (-> /), chapter-trigger-1..9 + chapter-content-1..9, book-final-buy-cta, book-final-whatsapp-link. Document title swaps to 'Currency Trading and Intermarket Analysis | Ashraf Laidi' on /book. Landing still shows hero, $550/$995 pricing, 2 SPONSORED floating ads on xl viewport.
rca of the issue: No issues to RCA — feature works as specified.
